title: Change the details registered with EnableNSW
summary: This page explains how to change your personal contact details if you receive assistance from EnableNSW.
intro:
If you receive assistance from EnableNSW and you need to change your personal contact details, you can do this by email or phone.

If you're requesting a change on behalf of someone, you must be an authorised contact person.
who_can_apply: You must receive assistance from EnableNSW.

how_to_steps.text: Email the details to enable@health.nsw.gov.au or call 1800 362 253.

external_links.text: Forms and funding criteria by program – EnableNSW

faqs.q: Who can request a change to the details?
faqs.a: If you are requesting a change on behalf of someone, you must be an authorised contact person.

faqs.q: How can I change my contact details?
faqs.a: You can change your personal contact details by emailing enable@health.nsw.gov.au or calling 1800 362 253.
